summary: PR 7378 replaced the generated per-module CODEOWNERS model with metadata-driven reviewer routing, with the routing automation re-homed in Azure/azure-verified-modules-tools. It merged on 2026-09-23 as a pure removal.
proposed: Approval rights should come from repository permissions alone, with only the people and teams listed in each module's metadata.json notified through a review request. The PR body says the original routing workflow ran in this repository and needed AVM GitHub App credentials.
changed: The PR body says the routing workflow was first triggered by pull_request_target, then reworked to a scheduled sweep, and finally moved to the tools repo so no AVM GitHub App credentials remain here. All four workflows that needed AVM_APP_CLIENT_ID / AVM_APP_PRIVATE_KEY were removed. The slice shows no review rounds.
shipped: A single commit merged the removal (+61 / -2,782 per the PR body) touching .github, .github/workflows, utilities/pipelines and utilities/tests; the routing implementation lives in the tools repo.
